title: Here are their biggest mistakes.  #metaadstips #facebookadvertisingti...
transcript: I just audited an ad account spending $300,000 on meta ads and these are the top mistakes that are killing the account. Number one is frequency. For an account of this size, we would expect a frequency of around 2, but dissecting each individual ad, 80% of it was a frequency of two or more, meaning they weren't introducing new concepts that were improving the top of funnel and going after net new reach, which is super important. We wanna ensure that our ad account has enough creatives sitting in the frequency of 1.5 and below in order to broaden out our net new reach. No.2 is the way they were testing whether it's CBO or Abo. This can really differentiate um across your account, but within their campaigns, they had assets broken up by product, assets broken up by persona and assets broken up by creative. You need to pick one and stick with it within that specific campaign so you can actually dissect the results that you are receiving. Number three is our creative cadence. For an account spending this much, we would expect weekly drops within the ad account and we would at least want 10 to fifteen, if not more creative to have not only creative volume, but also creative diversification. This account was only adding in fortnightly sprints, which just isn't enough for an ad account spending this much.
